coordinates.world: spine world: y up, world units
coordinates.image: the picture: y down, from its top-left corner; pixel (i, j) covers [i, i+1) x [j, j+1), so a position's pixel is its floor
coordinates.toPixel: px = x0 + (x - minX) * scale; py = y0 + (maxY - y) * scale — each tile's own transform
coordinates.toWorld: x = minX + (px - x0) / scale; y = maxY - (py - y0) / scale

bone.meaning: a bone's line, from its origin to its tip (origin + length along its world x axis)

origin.meaning: a bone's origin: a filled 3x3 square centred on the origin's pixel

tip.meaning: a bone's tip: a hollow 3x3 square centred on the tip's pixel

zero.meaning: a bone of length 0: a hollow 5x5 square around its origin, which is also its tip

name.meaning: a name label, starting 4 px right of and 3 px below its origin's pixel: one per pixel, so bones whose origins share a pixel are one label, the first by declaration order and "+N" for the rest (the legend's labels list every bone in it); a label that would overprint an earlier one is moved down a line at a time, with a leader back to its origin

leader.meaning: a label's leader, from its anchor pixel to the label — drawn where the label was moved to clear an earlier one

axisX.meaning: a bone's world x axis from its origin, 24 px long at a world scale of 1

axisY.meaning: a bone's world y axis from its origin, 24 px long at a world scale of 1

grid.meaning: a grid line at a whole multiple of the step, in world units, with its value at the edge

gridZero.meaning: the grid line at world x = 0 or y = 0

declared.meaning: an invariants.axes line, through its two bones' origins, across the whole tile

held.meaning: the line of a bone an invariants.axes entry holds to its line, in place of the bone colour

mesh.meaning: a mesh's triangle edge between two posed vertices — meshes only; a region is not drawn

hull.meaning: a mesh's hull, vertex 0 to 1 to … to hull−1 and back, drawn over its triangle edges — meshes only

slot.meaning: a slot's place in the posed draw order (0 is drawn first), from the centre of its attachment's box, on a white box

slotBack.meaning: the box under a slot number

label.meaning: a tile's build and poser (with --compare), time and frame (on a sheet), at its bottom-left corner
